result.title: Gearbox transmission error, Staubli TX2-40 axes 2 and 3 (speed holdout)
result.system: Staubli TX2-40 gearboxes on an experimental setup
result.quantity: theta_TE (rad) without compensation, at every published sample
result.baseline: B0: constant transmission error equal to the identification mean, per axis
result.model: as transmission-error-v2 (orders with >= 2 periods over the shortest identification recording, 30 largest up to 4000)
result.acceptance: per axis: validation RMSE(model) <= 0.5 x validation RMSE(B0) and validation RMSE(model) <= 1.5 x identification RMSE(model); X1 passes only if both axes pass (unchanged)

split.identification: identification/axis_k files whose velocity setpoint has an even rank (0, 2, 4, ...) when the setpoints of each sign are sorted by magnitude
split.validation: identification/axis_k files with odd rank (whole recordings, never mixed)
split.unused: validation/ folder: residual TE with the authors' compensation active (a different quantity); identification/axis_1

result.scope: external system; says nothing about the MotionProof reference gearbox or user hardware
